name: Polygenic risk scoring with clumping and high-resolution thresholding
model_likelihood: Regress target phenotype on PRS using a model appropriate to phenotype type; linear regression for continuous phenotypes.
inference_algorithm: P-value inclusion thresholding; optional LD clumping; compare target regression fit over an evenly spaced threshold grid.
estimand: Individual weighted genotype scores and target regression fit over thresholds; approximate best-fit score.
data_input: Base GWAS effect estimates and P-values plus target genotypes; independent target data in the described cross-trait design.
tunable_settings: SNP inclusion P-value thresholds; grid bounds and spacing; LD clumping window and r-squared threshold.
